headline: TOR @ DET matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is TOR 4.76 at DET 4.24, with a projected total of 9.00. Batter research is strongest for Riley Greene, Daulton Varsho, Kazuma Okamoto, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Spencer Torkelson, Jahmai Jones because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
